title: Automated Code Review for Legacy Migration
business: Software engineering firms managing large-scale legacy code migrations.
problem: Manual code review for legacy systems is prohibitively expensive and slow, often leading to technical debt accumulation during migration phases.
solution: Utilizing the o4-mini model to perform automated, reasoning-based code analysis on legacy modules, providing rapid feedback on potential refactoring needs before human intervention.
steps: Ingest legacy source files into the application pipeline.
Format code snippets and context as text inputs for the o4-mini model.
Invoke the Chat Completions endpoint with specific reasoning instructions for refactoring.
Parse the structured output to identify high-risk code blocks.
Route identified blocks to senior engineers for final validation.
outcome: A streamlined migration process where developers focus only on complex logic errors identified by the model, significantly reducing the initial review cycle time.
limitation: The model may occasionally hallucinate edge-case logic errors in highly obscure legacy languages; developers must verify critical path changes using unit tests.
